auto.label: Auto
auto.help: Concurrent runs on local/SSH runners; runs take turns in cloud environments.

serialize.label: Serialize
serialize.help: Sandbox runs take turns in the shared project workspace. Local/SSH folders allow concurrent runs.

allow.label: Allow
allow.help: Runs never wait for the workspace; concurrent edits are possible.

archiveHelp: Archive this project to hide it from the sidebar and project selectors.
unarchiveHelp: Unarchive this project to restore it in the sidebar and project selectors.
localFolderMustBeAbsolute: Local folder must be a full absolute path.
clearLocalFolderConfirm: Clear local folder from this workspace?
openConfirmTitle: Open this project to the company?
openConfirmBody: Everyone in the company will be able to discover this project. Its private tasks stay private. Members who only have access through this project will lose access to those tasks. Share tasks directly first if you want them to keep access.
privateHelp: Only access members can discover this project. Tasks shared directly remain readable on their own.
openHelp: Everyone in the company can discover this project. Individually private tasks keep their own access rules.
decisionOwnerHelp: A Needs You card on this project's work that names no person goes to this user's For you list.
codebaseTooltipManaged: Repo identifies the source of truth. Agents check it out in the platform-managed environment.
codebaseTooltipLocal: Repo identifies the source of truth. Local folder is the default place agents write code.
legacyWorkspaces: Additional legacy workspace records exist on this project. Paperclip is using the primary workspace as the codebase view.
storageChosen: {{provider}} workspace storage was chosen when this project was created and does not change.
executionWorkspacesTooltip: Project-owned defaults for isolated task checkouts and execution workspace behavior.
enableIsolatedHelp: Let tasks choose between the project's primary checkout and an isolated execution workspace.
defaultIsolated: New tasks default to isolated checkout
defaultIsolatedHelp: If disabled, new tasks stay on the project's primary checkout unless someone opts in.
runtimeProvisionHelp: Runs once before the first runtime-service start (heavy setup, e.g. DB seed). Leave empty to keep eager provisioning.
provisionHelp: Provision runs inside the derived worktree before agent execution. Teardown is stored here for future cleanup flows.
selectOrganizationForSecrets: Select an organization to create secrets
